    [#D7D7AF]mark-core: write the freshness-mark display contract and its M/N/C [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]conformance vectors into docs/freshness.md. Then implement the pure, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]exported bob-ledger-tools helpers (source detection, resolution, model, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]consensus, tooltip, DOM builder) and the mark styles, and test them [/#D7D7AF]

    [#AF87FF]mark-surfaces[dim] · [dim][/dim]after mark-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mark-surfaces: wire the model into Obsidian. Add a Prec.highest [/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]for reading view and Tasks query results, a filesystem-free cached mark [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]snapshot refreshed on the status bar paths, a session toggle command, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and the repair flag on leftover Dataview pills, all with stubbed [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]CodeMirror tests.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
